evidence.quote: Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon, not at close.

observations.why: Flat, unhedged operational assertion defended with a reason, but no ratification or performed settling language, so the claim/decision tear resolves lower to claim.

evidence.quote: Then the shelf card changes at two as well

observations.why: Plain assertion of a planned change, justified by a stated purpose; reads as a firm position still being argued, not a recorded settling, so claim over decision.
